messages:
samir: FYI ticket TKT-6142 from DynamicApps (acct:dyn-42) 1 says invoice INV-2026-193 shows a Dedicated burst charge that looks inflated. They suspect a duplicate burst row after a regional failover.
billing-bot: Invoice INV-2026-193 created 2026-04-10T11:05Z 1 total_due $12,100 1 https://billing.redwood/invoices/INV-2026-193
lina: dynamicapps support: 'We had a failover during the billing window and saw a big spike; the invoice burst line is ~85k tokens but our internal logs show ~42k extra tokens only. Can you reconcile?'
frank: Quick check: committed 60k tokens/month per contract. Pre-bill export shows ~102k total -> burst ~42k. Invoice burst line shows 84k. Looks like duplication by factor ~2.
zoe: If the overcharge is ~42k tokens and our burst rate is $0.08 per 1k tokens, that implies ~ $3,360. That's under the $5k finance lead threshold, so I can sign off provisional credit.
frank: Possible cause: during the failover the billing-forwarder retried events and upstream XA consumer wrote the same burst batch twice (we saw identical event_ids). I can run a dedupe on the window and produce corrected usage.csv.
samir: Please hold collection on INV-2026-193 until we reconcile. Lina, I'll tell DynamicApps we're pausing collection and will provide a corrected invoice + proforma credit within 48 hours.
lina: Thanks. They're also asking whether they'll get an SLA credit for the failover window (they reported 9 minutes of reduced capacity). They want both the billing fix and SLA consideration.
frank: We should separate the two: billing duplication is clearly our fault and fixable. SLA credit requires ops confirmation of SLO breach. I'll ping eng-SRE to confirm outage window and postback here.
zoe: Approve provisional collection hold and provisional credit $3,360 pending final recon. Finance ledger tag LC-2026-078 created. I'll post the credit once corrected usage file is validated.
billing-bot: Invoice INV-2026-193 status -> collection_hold; ticket TKT-6142 opened.
samir: Message to DynamicApps sent: 'We've paused collection and are investigating. Expect a proforma credit memo and corrected invoice within 48h. We'll also confirm whether an SLA credit applies.'
frank: Mitigation: deployed idempotency key check to billing-forwarder (release v1.3.7) and queued dedupe job for 2026-04-09T10:00-12:00 window. I will upload corrected CSV to s3://billing-exports/2026/04/dyn-42/corrected_INV-2026-193.csv when done.
zoe: Once corrected export is in and counts reconcile, finance will post the $3,360 credit and reissue invoice. If SRE confirms an SLO breach, we'll calculate SLA credit separately and apply per the contract.
lina: I'll keep the customer updated and ask their AP for any temporary hold paperwork. Thanks everyone.
